title: introduce-per-tenant-streaming-metrics-relay-and-cost-anomaly-replayer
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: production SREs requested lower-noise tenant-level streaming metrics and an operator-friendly way to replay cost anomalies in staging for RCA. This PR introduces a lightweight per-tenant streaming metrics relay that buffers and rate-limits high-cardinality token-level metrics before ingest, plus an anomaly replayer that can reconstruct a minimal request stream to reproduce cost/latency spikes in a controlled environment. Changes include a new relay worker, a replay CLI, dashboard panels, and alert squelch integration. Checklist: [x] relay worker implementation; [x] replay CLI + unit tests; [x] dashboard JSON and panel wiring; [x] alert rule updates and canary rollout plan; [x] docs draft. Testing: unit + integration against local relay harness, e2e replay against staging with synthetic tenant. Rollout: gradual feature-flagged rollout to 5 tenants for 48h then region-by-region. Related: ENG-3214 (tenant observability roadmap), ENG-3299 (replay capability for oncall).

cli/replay/replayer.py - replay CLI that synthesizes token streams from sampled traces
sdk/python/redwood/observability/replay.py - client helper for generating replay bundles
scripts/staging_bootstrap/replay_canary.sh - helper to run replays in staging

services/ingest/README.md - notes about compatibility and migration
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Overall looks good. A few questions: how does the relay affect our current token-level cardinality budgets? Can we add a knob for per-tenant hard caps?
Asha Menon: Responding - relay enforces per-tenant leaky-bucket plus global shard-level backpressure. Added config schema with per-tenant hard_cap and admission_policy (reject/queue-sample).
Samir Patel: Replay CLI is powerful but potentially dangerous. We need to ensure it cannot be run against prod by mistake. Suggest adding an allowlist and a required --confirm-token flag.
Asha Menon: Agreed. Added allowlist check and --confirm-token gating; CLI will refuse to target prod endpoints unless explicitly whitelisted via env var.
Lin Zhou: Alert squelch semantics are unclear when relay is enabled. If we sample aggressively we might suppress real incidents. Recommend adding an SLA-exempt path for high-severity alerts.
Asha Menon: Implemented adaptive-squelch with severity exemptions; added unit tests and updated alert docs to describe exemptions.
ci_summary: Security scan: passed (no new high findings)
E2E replay smoke against staging: passed
release_notes: Adds a tenant-level streaming metrics relay to reduce high-cardinality ingestion pressure and an anomaly replayer CLI to reproduce cost/latency spikes in staging. Includes dashboard panels and adaptive alert squelch. Feature-gated rollout planned.
notes_for_oncall: When relay is enabled for a tenant, most token-level counters may be sampled or aggregated; use the replay CLI to reconstruct exact sequences for RCA. If you see unexpected alert suppression, check tenant_squelch_rules and the severity exemption list. Relay logs available at observability/relay/<shard>/year/month/day/
